title: Strategic Patience
content: Although the war with Iran has inflicted higher energy prices on the world, companies involved in US energy exports have been among the biggest beneficiaries. The availability of oil and gas that doesn’t need to dodge Iranian missiles in the Strait of Hormuz or Houthis as it exits the Red Sea has boosted US trade. Oil exports are running at 5.7 Million Barrels per Day (MMB/D), +57% compared with a year ago.
